objective:
A report-RENDERING task on the 1.5.0 document (no engine, schema, maps, kit or fixture change). (A) PAGE TYPE 3 (page_option_comparison.py, options.py, drawings_embed.py): the 11-row table comes FIRST; the '

Limitation N.' paragraphs are removed from the section (the material limitations are preserved as appendix issue records, R025, not deleted); options 1-3 carry figures and options 4-11 are compact 'Not evaluated in this report' rows in the owner-approved order (never readable as infeasibility or achieved-on-site, R059/R084); the bar chart distinguishes floor-area allowance / scheduled area / placed-on-site ('Not demonstrated', no bar) on one zero-based scale, never two equal bars and never a zero-height bar for an unknown (R018/R020). (B) PAGE TYPES 5 AND 6 AS ONE CLEARLY-NAMED EVIDENCE APPENDIX (page_assumptions.py, page_evidence.py merged via builder.py + layout.py; the section-id list, page-type question list and page count in test_report_pages.py reworked, 6 sections -> 5): five-field issue records (issue / consequence / next action / responsible role / evidence reference) with site documents kept apart from program work and the honest 'not yet' sentence at most once (R025/R054); worked arithmetic 10,075 x 2.0 = 20,150 and 20,150 / 680 = 29.63 -> 29 with each input NAMING ITS BASIS read from the 1.5.0 input_facts block using ONLY the nine closed bases' plain-word labels (gis -> 'city map outline (GIS)', administrative_record -> 'recorded lot area') with source title and date, never a GIS outline called 'tax map'/'tax-map outline' (G-10), no single figure mixing two bases (R023/R026/G-10) - the current input_rows reader does not read input_facts, so this is new reading in readers.py with a new nine-bases label map; each result mapped to its EXISTING review-register entry and review state (R027; the register itself is out of scope, G-11/M5-T172); run identity = a fingerprint stable for the same document excluding results_id and computed_at (changing when any value changes) plus the deployed code commit (new run_identity.py; commit read from the build_info env source, 'unknown' when unset), with every diagram/result citing the same revision/scenario (R028/R038/R058); the area-illustration METHOD (R095/R092) - the stated share, the measure, the G-14 statement 'plate = zoning floor area per storey; no gross-up, exclusions or wall-thickness conversion worked', the bar-or-zones rule and its register entry - rendered from the document's area_allocation block when present (tests use M5-T164's example fixtures; absent on the benchmark until M5-T172); the status-label key once (the only place 'Verified' appears). (C) The largest-remainder display helper in formatting.py (M5-T173 only reads it) with an explicit boundary justification: it re-rounds document-provided shares to sum to 100 and computes no zoning quantity. (D) report_read.py carries the run identity to the live route. readers.py is in NB-01 code_paths -> NB-01 gets a revision with recomputed LF-normalized code identity and a G1 agent delta review; behaviour byte-identical on a 1.4.0 document.
